plugins.name: product-cycle
plugins.description: Product-discovery state machine: idle -> scoping -> researching -> hypothesis-registered -> measuring -> decided. Registers the metric, threshold, and decision rule before any data is collected; the gated hypothesis-registered -> measuring transition requires both the registered package and an approval token minted from the user's own turn; the threshold is frozen once measuring starts; decided applies the registered rule mechanically.

plugins.name: product-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install environment bundle: installs product-cycle via dependency.
